implementation_contract.evidence_reuse: Reuse the existing exact EngineeringSnapshot only. Do not modify or reimplement audio_engineering.py or its pinned loudness backend.

implementation_contract.fallback: If integrated loudness is unavailable on either side, preserve the exact state and use whole-render RMS only when both sides have exact RMS. RMS is never perceptual loudness.

implementation_contract.read_only: Preparing or viewing comparison remains read-only with no audio, Song, Version, Learning, decision, provider, or DAW mutation.
